ex.en: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure
And grain having husks and scented plants

And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind - its morning [journey was that of] a month - and its afternoon [journey was that of] a month, and We made flow for him a spring of [liquid] copper. And among the jinn were those who worked for him by the permission of his Lord. And whoever deviated among them from Our command - We will make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze

forms.gloss: to bring home in the evening

ex.en: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture]
